fullName.value: Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 2

texts.value: Calcium-permeable, non-selective cation channel (PubMed:10201375). Seems to be regulated, at least in part, by growth factors, such as IGF1, PDGF and morphogenetic neuropeptide/head activator. May transduce physical stimuli in mast cells (By similarity)

Activated by temperatures higher than 52 degrees Celsius (PubMed:10201375). Weakly activated by cannabinoid that binds to the vanilloid binding pocket; this activation is potentiated by the binding of uricosuric agents like probenecid (By similarity)

Homotetramer (By similarity). Interacts with a cAMP-dependent protein kinase type II regulatory subunit (PRKAR2A or PRKAR2B) and ACBD3 (By similarity). Interacts with SLC50A1; the interaction probably occurs intracellularly and depends on TRPV2 N-glycosylation (By similarity)
Translocates from the cytoplasm to the plasma membrane upon ligand stimulation (By similarity). Expressed in melanosomes during melanosome maturation from stage I to stage IV
Belongs to the transient receptor (TC 1.A.4) family. TrpV subfamily. TRPV2 sub-subfamily
